Driving innovation in low-power, mixed-signal technology

Cirrus Logic is the trusted expert solving the most demanding mixed-signal challenges. Cirrus Logic develops high-performance, low-power audio and mixed-signal processing solutions for a broad range of consumer, automotive, and industrial applications. With global headquarters in the US, we invest in talent, research and development, and innovation with locations throughout the US, Europe, and Asia.
Cirrus Logic delivers advanced hardware, software, and algorithms to help customers create differentiated user experiences and industry-defining products.
Engineering Precision and Driving Innovation
High-precision A/D converters for low-noise, low-latency audio and industrial use.
Smart amplifiers that maximize loudness and audio quality while protecting your speakers.
Highly-integrated audio codecs combining ADCs and DACs for capture and playback.
High-fidelity D/A converters turning digital audio into pristine analog sound.
Low-jitter clock generation ICs that keep audio systems perfectly synchronized.

raw_blocks: Solving the Most Demanding Mixed-Signal Challenges

Cirrus Logic is the trusted expert solving the most demanding mixed-signal challenges. We engineer the precision, performance, and power efficiency that enable the world’s leading brands to build exceptional products.

We create high-performance audio and mixed-signal solutions that help turn real-world signals into smarter, more seamless experiences. From sound and images to touch and data, our technology brings power efficiency and reliable performance to create differentiated user experiences across consumer electronics, including smartphones, tablets, and laptops, in addition to a variety of applications in automotive, industrial, and prosumer audio.
Cirrus Logic delivers advanced hardware, software, and algorithms to help customers create differentiated user experiences and industry-defining products.
Our culture is shaped by a shared set of core values that guide how we lead, work, grow, and succeed together.

Cirrus Logic is widely recognized for being more than a company, but rather a community. The best ideas emerge when diverse teams work and learn together. We balance that with building connections through shared fun experiences, community giving, and volunteering that bring people together and make it easy to feel like you belong.
Global Top 100 Inspiring Places to Work
Get to know our leaders whose curiosity, discipline, and collaboration help drive innovation across our organization.

Our resources are focused on designing products, optimizing operations, supporting customers, and empowering teams around the world. We outsource the manufacturing process to a network of global suppliers for fabrication, assembly, test, and distribution.

pages.raw_meta: Explore Cirrus Logic PC audio and haptics solutions for richer sound, clearer calls and responsive trackpad feedback, even in thin designs.
raw_blocks: Create Incredible PC Devices With Richer Sound and Satisfying Haptics
Turn each call, sound, song, click, and gesture into your distinctive sound with high-performance codecs, smart amplification, precision haptics, and expert tuning.
Superb sound and satisfying PC experiences
Smart amplification, speaker protection, and DSP create output, bass response, and reliability customers demand in thin, constrained form factors.
Closed-loop haptics and programmable effects give PC teams greater control over feel and consistency for trackpads and peripherals.
Compare capabilities and discover products that get the most out of your next design.
More capability, whatever the form factor
Extend audio and haptic technologies across product lines while balancing capability, cost, and experience for each design.
Create a signature sound and feel
Turn every call, playback session, and trackpad interaction into a more compelling reason users choose your product.
Get more from every product
Balance power, mechanics, and cost to unlock ambitious audio and haptic experiences within challenging design limits.
Align the technologies behind audio, haptics, and voice so teams can spend less time managing subsystem dependencies and more time refining the product experience.
Designed for production at scale
Combine validated hardware and software with testing, tools, and engineering support that help teams move from design-in to volume production.
Proven expertise for your products

Put more than 40 years of experience behind the decisions that shape performance, implementation, and long-term production. Work through system tradeoffs, product requirements, and lifecycle commitments with a partner invested beyond component selection.
Accelerate evaluation and integration with SoundClear Studio
Quality you can plan around
